_help: Decor for the sunroom (the hub). slot: which kind of hub slot it fits (floor_large, floor_small, wall, table, rug). price: seashells (null = can only be earned, see rewards.json). size: sprite size in stage pixels. To add an item: draw assets/sprites/props/decor/<id>.svg and add an entry here.

linen_sofa.name: Linen sofa
linen_sofa.text: Deep, soft and perfect for sunrise naps.

potted_palm.name: Potted palm
potted_palm.text: A little palm that dreams of the beach.

rattan_chair.name: Peacock chair
rattan_chair.text: A grand rattan chair for grand thoughts.

fiddle_leaf.name: Fiddle-leaf fig
fiddle_leaf.text: Dramatic, leafy and a little bit fussy.

record_crate.name: Record crate
record_crate.text: Bossa nova, jazz and one mysterious polka record.

cushion_pile.name: Floor cushions
cushion_pile.text: For friends, cats and afternoon reading.

floor_lamp.text: A warm glow for after the sun goes down.

string_lanterns.name: Paper lanterns

seascape_painting.name: Seascape painting
seascape_painting.text: Painted by Mamie on a very windy afternoon.

fishing_net.name: Fishing net
fishing_net.text: Full of shells, a starfish and good memories.

telescope.text: For spotting boats, whales and the first sunbeam.

grandma_portrait.name: Portrait of Céline
